Answering your questions

We know you might have some questions, so here are some of our most frequently asked ones.

Who are Alternative Airlines?

Never heard of us? We get it, we do things a little differently.


We’re all about putting you in control and giving you the freedom to travel your way. Compare flights from over 600 airlines, add the extras you need, and choose how to pay, upfront or over time, all in one simple place.


Once you’ve booked your flight, our dedicated customer support team is here 7 days a week to help with anything you need.

Can I pay later for my flights?

Yes. At Alternative Airlines, we offer over 40 ways to pay, including flexible pay-later options that let you split the cost or book now and pay the rest later.


Alternative Airlines works with leading global providers like Affirm, Afterpay, Klarna, Tamara, Atome and many more. This means you can choose a payment plan that works for your budget, whether that's splitting your flight cost into 3-4 weekly instalments or paying a small deposit now and the rest before departure.


Most pay-later options don't require a hard credit check, and many come with zero interest when you pay on time. We've built the world's most flexible flight booking experience so you can book your trip today without paying everything up front

Can I add seats and bags after booking?

Yes. At Alternative Airlines, you can add seats and bags to your booking after you've completed your purchase.


Once your flight is confirmed, you can manage your booking through our Manage My Booking portal. Use your booking reference and last name to access your booking.


Our Customer Service team can help you add extras to your booking. Contact the team if you need help selecting seats, adding luggage or making other changes to your journey.

How do I know my booking is confirmed?

We will send an instant booking confirmation once your payment is complete. You'll receive a confirmation email with your booking reference, flight details and e-ticket numbers within minutes of booking.


Check your inbox for an email from Alternative Airlines with the subject line 'Booking Confirmation and E-Ticket'. This email includes everything you need: your booking reference, flight times, airline details and passenger information. If you don't see your confirmation email within 24 hours of booking, check your spam folder or contact us. The team can resend your confirmation and help with any booking questions.

What happens if I need to cancel my flight?

Contact Alternative Airlines' Customer Service team as soon as possible if you need to cancel your flight.


Our friendly team can check your airline's cancellation policy and help you understand your options. Cancellation terms depend on the airline you've booked with and the fare type you selected. Some airlines offer flexible fares that allow free cancellations within 24 hours, while others charge cancellation fees.


If you purchased Cancellation Protection when booking and need to cancel due to an emergency, you may be eligible for a refund. We can process your cancellation request and help you claim any eligible refunds. The team stays with you through the process, making cancellations less of a hassle to deal with.

Need more help?

Visit our help center for any additional assistance. Our team is also available 7 days a week if you need extra support.
